data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a horizon parameter k on attack edges: an edge is active only if its warrant chain has length at most k. Compute the grounded extension for each k and define the eventual skeptical status as the stable value for all sufficiently large k. This yields a graded notion of groundedness that can be decided in polynomial time by iterating k up to the node count, preserves determinism, and makes reinstatement a property of eventual stabilization; it can be criticized for changing the fixed point on cycles and for possibly requiring large k.
